第55章 送别-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

直到结账的时候，吴姜才暗暗咂舌，就这么一顿，就吃掉了朱宏足足一个月的俸禄。

朱宏是坐镇地府的阴差，俸禄计算方式和他这种鬼差不一样，他的贡献点是靠捉拿厉鬼获得，而朱宏的俸禄，是地府按月发放的。

吴姜通过和朱宏的几次聊天，早就知道了，所谓的贡献点，其实就是功德。

兑换中心里，那些术法、法器的提供者，他们提供这些东西，就是为了获取功德。

就像吴姜上次兑换的基础符箓大全，就是茅山派提供的，那些历代的茅山大佬，死后大多都在地府任职，功德对他们来说，也很重要。

吃饱喝足，吴姜和朱宏告别，带着念念，转身朝着阴阳通道走去。

回到阳间，天已经蒙蒙亮，吴姜睡到九点，才去敲响了隔壁的房门。

房门一打开，朱子明和郭云涛就猛地冲了上来，一把将吴姜拉住，不等他反应过来，就直接把他按在了床上。

“四蛋子，你完了......”

朱子明和郭云涛一左一右按住吴姜，一边伸手挠他的痒痒，将他是一通收拾。

郭云涛一边挠一边咬牙切齿地骂：“妈的，要不是老子醒得早，差点菊花不保！”

一旁的朱子明立马不乐意了，抬手就拍了郭云涛后脑勺一巴掌，愤愤反驳：“放屁！明明是老子差点成了受害者！”

吴姜被挠得浑身发软，笑得直不起腰，一边扭动身子挣扎，一边连连求饶：“别挠了别挠了！我错了我错了！下次再也不敢了！”

两人停止内讧，又对着吴姜上下齐手了半分钟，这才放过了他。

闹够了，三人这才停下，不过，分别的时间也到了。

吴姜从口袋里掏出三个红色小布袋，里面是三张护身符，递到朱子明手里。

“给你和叔叔阿姨的礼物，这是我在一位大师那儿求来的，据说特别灵验，能挡灾避祸。信我的话，就随身带着，别弄丢了。”

吴姜故作随意的说道，朱子明也不客气，直接接过放在了兜里。

“放心吧，知道是蛋子你的一番心意，哥哥肯定天天带着，就算不信佛，也得信你！”

It wasn't until the time of checkout that Wu Jiang secretly smacked his tongue. In just one meal, Zhu Hong had eaten up a full month's salary.

Zhu Hong is a Yin Zai who is in charge of the underworld, and his salary calculation method is different from that of a ghost like him. His contribution points are obtained by catching ghosts, while Zhu Hong's salary is paid out on a monthly basis by the Underworld.

Wu Jiang had already known through several chats with Zhu Hong that the so-called contribution points were actually merit.

In the exchange center, the providers of spells and magic tools provide these things just to gain merit.

Just like the collection of basic talismans that Wu Jiang exchanged last time was provided by the Maoshan sect. Most of the Maoshan bosses in the past served in the underworld after their death, and merit was also very important to them.

After eating and drinking, Wu Jiang said goodbye to Zhu Hong, turned around and walked towards the Yin and Yang passage with thoughts in mind.

When he returned to the earth, it was already dawn. Wu Jiang slept until nine o'clock before knocking on the door next door.

As soon as the door opened, Zhu Ziming and Guo Yuntao rushed forward, grabbed Wu Jiang, and pressed him directly onto the bed before he could react.

"Sidanzi, you're done..."

Zhu Ziming and Guo Yuntao held Wu Jiang down one on the left and the other on the right, and stretched out their hands to scratch his itch, cleaning him up.

Guo Yuntao scratched and cursed through gritted teeth: "Damn it, if I hadn't woken up early, I almost would have lost my anus!"

Zhu Ziming on the side immediately became unhappy, raised his hand and slapped Guo Yuntao on the back of the head, and retorted angrily: "Fart! It's obvious that I almost became the victim!"

Wu Jiang was so scratched that his whole body went limp, and he couldn't stand upright with laughter. While twisting and struggling, he repeatedly begged for mercy: "Stop scratching, stop scratching! I was wrong, I was wrong! I won't dare to do it again next time!"

The two stopped fighting among themselves and faced Wu Jiang with their hands up and down for another half minute before letting him go.

After enough trouble, the three of them stopped, but the time to part ways had also come.

Wu Jiang took out three small red cloth bags from his pocket, which contained three amulets, and handed them to Zhu Ziming's hand.

"This is a gift for you and your uncle and aunt. I asked for it from a master. It is said to be very effective and can ward off disasters. If you believe me, take it with you and don't lose it."

Wu Jiang pretended to be casual and said, Zhu Ziming was not polite and took it directly and put it in his pocket.

"Don't worry, I know it's your intention, Danzi. Brother will definitely carry it with me every day. Even if I don't believe in Buddhism, I still have to believe in you!"
